premises.text: Regular status reports are often inaccessible to the wider company, leading to uninformed decisions and duplicated work.
premises.evidence_span: these communications that are loaded with valuable business information are sent by email from one person to another, and the rest of the company can't access them

premises.text: ThinkVue simplifies the process of creating and sharing status reports.
premises.evidence_span: all we need to know is who you want status reports from, when you want them, and what information they should include

premises.text: Status reports can be made more consistent and timely through ThinkVue.
premises.evidence_span: their status reports are more consistent than they've ever been. They're more timely.

premises.text: ThinkVue allows users to follow projects and receive updates, enhancing communication.
premises.evidence_span: each of these people can follow a project just as easily as they can follow someone on Twitter

premises.text: Mapping relationships between people and projects can provide valuable insights for decision-making.
premises.evidence_span: we're mapping the relationships between people and projects in a company

premises.text: ThinkVue enables users to search for expertise within their company based on status reports.
premises.evidence_span: she can come to ThinkFuse when she's looking for an engineer with expertise in solar power systems

premises.text: Access to status reports can help align people and resources across an organization.
premises.evidence_span: ThinkFuse provides this understanding by making status reports more accessible, by making them more consistent, and more powerful to align people and resources across an organization

value.text: Companies can make better-informed decisions and reduce duplicated work through improved access to status reports.
value.evidence_span: companies lose money because of this
